args.title: checkout-api unhealthy after v2.3.1 deploy - rolled back to v2.3.0
args.summary: checkout-api began failing health checks after the latest deploy of v2.3.1 to production (error rate 18%, unhealthy in all regions: us-east, us-west, eu-west). Rolled back to the most recent healthy production release, v2.3.0, in all regions. Rollback verified as rolled out. Investigating root cause of v2.3.1 regression.

trace.final:
Done. Here's a summary of what I did:

1. **Investigated**: `checkout-api` was running v2.3.1 in all regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west) with health checks failing and an 18% error rate. Deployment history confirmed v2.3.1 was the latest production release and unhealthy, while v2.3.0 was the most recent healthy production release.

2. **Rolled back**: Rolled `checkout-api` back to **v2.3.0** in all production regions. The rollback was verified as rolled out.

3. **Opened incident**: Created SEV2 incident **INC-0001** ("checkout-api unhealthy after v2.3.1 deploy - rolled back to v2.3.0"), which paged the on-call engineer, documenting the failure and the rollback action.

4. **Verified recovery**: Post-rollback status shows `checkout-api` on v2.3.0 in all regions, healthy, with error rate back down to 0.2%.

Note: The root cause of the v2.3.1 regression is still under investigation (tracked in INC-0001).
